use_cases: Linking to v0.dev from documentation or demos to open generated UI components
Providing developers a quick action to export and iterate on UI in v0's environment
Adding v0 integration to component libraries or design systems
ai_summary: A utility button component that wraps the Button primitive and creates an external link to v0.dev's component export API. Features dual-tone styling with hover states for both light and dark modes, accessible aria-label, and an embedded v0 SVG logo. Designed specifically for dev-tools and component library integration, enabling one-click export of UI components to the v0 platform for further iteration.
